verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community indexing tip that mentions bulk indexing in Elasticsearch, which implies bulk ingestion exists. There is no first-party documentation of a bulk API, its throughput at millions of documents, or any async task tracking for indexing completion. Missing for 10: first-party docs for a bulk indexing API, evidence of throughput at millions-of-documents scale, async task/status tracking to know when indexing completes, and independent benchmarks.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can bulk-import millions of documents quickly, with async task tracking to know when indexing completes

citations.quote: consider disabling it entirely during bulk indexing
